forecast_metadata.ensemble_members_note: Not documented -- no raw ensemble member data or count exists anywhere in this pipeline. Drought/Wet Probability layers ARE real ensemble-derived exceedance probabilities and are used elsewhere as the confidence proxy (see probability_layer_evidence), but a member count for them isn't recorded.

forecast_metadata.climatology_period_note: Not documented in this pipeline -- climatology/anomaly rasters exist and are used directly (see departure_from_climatology), but the specific reference period they were computed against isn't recorded in this dataset.
forecast_metadata.livestock_source: FAO/Harvard Dataverse Gridded Livestock of the World v4 (2015)

rainfall_total.label: Rainfall Total
rainfall_total.interpretation: Total accumulated rainfall for the period. Positive anomaly does not automatically imply flooding -- check Rx1day/Rx5day and CWD for intensity/duration risk.

spi.label: SPI (Standardized Precipitation Index)
spi.interpretation: More negative values indicate greater dryness relative to the region's own climatological rainfall distribution. Negative SPI does not necessarily imply severe agricultural impact unless exposure and vulnerability are also high.

cdd.label: CDD (Consecutive Dry Days)
cdd.interpretation: Higher positive anomaly means longer-than-normal dry spells. High CDD usually increases drought concern.

cwd.label: CWD (Consecutive Wet Days)
cwd.interpretation: Higher positive anomaly means longer continuous wet spells. High CWD can benefit crops but also increase waterlogging and disease risk -- do not treat it as uniformly positive or uniformly negative.

rx1day.label: Rx1day (Maximum 1-day rainfall)
rx1day.interpretation: Maximum one-day rainfall amount. High positive anomaly may indicate flash-flood risk. Should not be interpreted identically to Rx5day -- Rx1day reflects short, intense bursts, not sustained accumulation.

rx5day.label: Rx5day (Maximum 5-day rainfall)
rx5day.interpretation: Maximum consecutive five-day rainfall total. High positive anomaly may indicate saturation and river-flood risk -- a distinct hazard mechanism from Rx1day's flash-flood signal.

rainfall_percentile.label: Rainfall Percentile
rainfall_percentile.interpretation: Where this period's rainfall ranks against the climatological distribution at each location. 50 is the climatological median; departure from 50 is the meaningful signal, not the raw percentile alone.
